## 🎯 **Key Features**

### **Authentication System**
- User registration and login functionality
- Secure data storage using AsyncStorage
- First registered user becomes admin automatically

### **Category-Based Learning**
- **4 word categories**: Animals, Colors, Food, Family Members
- **Progressive unlocking**: Complete one category to unlock the next
- **Word learning**: Tap cards to reveal definitions and examples
- **Progress tracking**: Visual progress indicators for each category

### **Testing System**
- **Comprehensive tests** for each completed category
- **5-minute time limit** with countdown timer
- **70% passing score** required to unlock next category
- **Multiple choice questions** with randomized options

### **User Progress Management**
- **Individual user data** stored locally
- **Progress statistics**: Categories completed, words learned, streak tracking
- **Visual progress charts** using doughnut diagrams
- **Category-specific progress** tracking

### **Admin Dashboard**
- **Admin users** can view all user data
- **User statistics** including progress and performance
- **Comprehensive data overview** for management

## 🎨 **Design Features**

### **Modern UI/UX**
- **Light theme** with clean, minimalistic design
- **Smooth animations** and transitions
- **Intuitive navigation** with proper back buttons
- **Visual feedback** for user interactions

### **Progress Visualization**
- **Doughnut charts** for completion percentages
- **Progress bars** for category advancement
- **Achievement badges** for completed categories
- **Real-time statistics** updates

## 📱 **App Structure**

### **Main Screens**
- **Home Screen**: Category overview with progress stats
- **Category Screen**: Word learning interface
- **Test Screen**: Interactive testing with timer
- **Profile Screen**: User stats and admin panel
- **Auth Screens**: Login and registration

### **Components**
- **CategoryCard**: Interactive category display
- **WordCard**: Flip-to-reveal word learning
- **ProgressChart**: Visual progress indicators
- **Custom Button**: Consistent UI elements

## 🔧 **Technical Implementation**

- **Local storage** using AsyncStorage
- **Type-safe** TypeScript interfaces

### **State Management**
- **Custom hooks** for authentication
- **React state** for UI management
- **Persistent data** across app sessions

Users can learn words systematically, take tests to prove their knowledge, and unlock new content as they progress. Administrators can monitor all user activity and progress through the dedicated admin panel.
